title: Investigate and fix flaky CI tests (payment-service)
description:
Several CI test runs for payment-service have been failing intermittently over the past 2 weeks. The failures are timing-dependent and cluster in tests/test_auth.py around async token validation.

Tests failing intermittently:
- test_token_refresh_timing
- test_concurrent_validation
- test_rate_limit_window

This is blocking merge confidence and slowing deployment velocity. Investigate and fix at the root cause.
scope: Fix timing-dependent tests in payment-service test suite
